The Market This Week - Oct 30 to Nov 5

Rates first: the 30-year fixed averaged 7.18% as of Nov 5 (Freddie Mac), down from 7.24%. Greater Atlanta had 21,372 homes for sale in October, about 5.2 months of supply. Local: Henry County passed a property tax relief sales tax and turned down the road sales tax; Rockdale passed a property tax relief sales tax; Spalding passed its road sales tax by 128 votes.
